blends.name: Rare SPApa Parts (COMPLETED!)
blends.desc:
This blend is used to upgrade the Rare "Under Construction" SPApa Parts Card to its Rare "Constructed" form, AKA: "SPApa Parts".

You'll need 1x SPApa Parts (Under Construction) card as well as 1x SPA Sticker in order to upgrade.

For members planning to blend more than one card; please note that each member may only blend a maximum of 1 card every 30 minutes until supplies (25x) last.

blends.name: Rare SPApa Parts (Under Construction - Step 1)
blends.desc:
This Card requires ***2*x Common** "SPApa Parts" Cards to be traded in exchange for **1*x* Rare** "SPApa Parts *(Under Contruction - Step 1)*" Card.

You will need this "*Under Construction - Step 1*" Card as an **EXCHANGE INGREDIENT** in constructing the FINAL version of the Rare "SPApa Parts" Card upon its design completion (details below);

__**LATER (Design Completion):**__
We are currently pending the STICKER TRADE IN EVENT wherein users will (later) be able to trade in SPA Stickers in order to get exclusive trade-in SPA Tickets and their NAMES ETCHED onto the back of the FINAL "SPApa Parts" card before its final release.

Whoever TRADES IN the most stickers and ultimately **HOLDS THE MOST IN STANDARD EQUIVALENT TICKET VALUE** by the end of the event will be granted the #1 Contributor slot, 2nd most trade-ins will earn the #2 Contributor slot, 3rd gets the #3 slot, 4th gets #4 and 5th gets #5 - anybody else that trades in (and holds tickets) during that period will earn themselves an ETCHING into the back of the card.

*Contingency:*
In the result of any tie-breaker requirements; Funguy [Owner] will have final say based primarily on whoever has the lowest average mint # spread.

*Rare stickers that have become fired up are upgraded to Legendary status!*
